automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.date_policy: Only visibly published or updated timestamps strictly inside the window qualify; date-only lower-boundary candidates are excluded.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams added multi-repository conversations, shared Slack-message and thread context, smoother repository switching, and interruption-recovery improvements.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: A shared-channel workflow now needs explicit repository-set, channel-context, and recovery boundaries before treating the session as a cross-repository work record.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Keep the product release upstream-owned; ingest only the downstream shared-session context and recovery implications.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Enterprise-managed Copilot settings can require a fresh policy retrieval at startup and fail closed when current policy cannot be confirmed; the sandbox setting also gains minimum-client-version enforcement.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Execution authorization should record policy freshness and client-version preconditions, not only the policy value that was intended to apply.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Treat this as a local fail-closed authorization pattern rather than a local GitHub product page.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Agentic autofix explores a codebase, proposes a remediation, reruns CodeQL, and opens a draft pull request; it is policy-gated and consumes AI Credits and Actions minutes.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Automated security repair needs provenance, validation evidence, draft-review gates, enablement approval, and cost-budget evidence before the change is accepted.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Preserve the local repair-control implication; do not duplicate GitHub feature documentation.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The remediation flow iterates through validation and opens a draft pull request containing a fix summary, closure rationale, and validation steps.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: An agent-created repair branch should package the verification receipt and remain draft until an authorized reviewer accepts the fix.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use as downstream branch-and-PR evidence only.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Agentic remediation returns a draft pull request with why the alert closes and the validation performed after codebase-wide exploration.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Review practice should distinguish the agent's reported closure rationale from independently accepted evidence and retain both with the PR.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Do not treat vendor-provided validation as sufficient independent review.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Anthropic announced employee-like evaluator access for METR, with publication of risk-assessment results, alongside work with other evaluators.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: A credible technical evaluation should specify evaluator independence, access scope, publication or disclosure commitments, and the decision the evaluation can affect.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route broad organization and model information upstream; retain the local evaluator-independence checklist implication.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The announcement describes external evaluator access and publication of risk-assessment results rather than relying only on provider-owned testing.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Consequential review-eval claims need a defined independent-review path and a publication or auditable-disclosure expectation in addition to internal rubric scores.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Record the rubric-design implication, not vendor background.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Independent evaluators can receive enhanced access and publish risk-assessment findings, providing a distinct assurance role from the developer's own graders.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Keep developer-owned automated judges separate from independent assessment whenever the result informs high-consequence safety or release decisions.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use as an assurance-boundary example; upstream owns vendor and evaluator profiles.

excluded_candidates.reason: Published date is 2026-10-07, outside the strict seven-day window.
A broad provider-model lifecycle update is upstream-owned; no distinct local-practice change was established for the selected portability leaf.

Not recorded for AI-assisted TDD, generated-code refactoring, browser runtime boundaries, context request packages, partner selection, or outcome autonomy because it did not supply a distinct new practice for those leaves.
